scores.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright supplies naval propulsion/auxiliary equipment to the Virginia-class submarine program.
supports: usaspending.query_dod_contracts(recipient_name='Curtiss-Wright') returned 2,362 DoD awards totalling $325M+ in sample, with top contracts under NAVSEA prefix N00104 awarded to 'CURTISS-WRIGHT ELECTRO-MECHANICAL CORPORATION' ($57.6M and $33.3M top-3 NAVSEA contracts) — consistent with the naval-propulsion claim.
scores.interpretation: Per heuristic 7, NOT_FOUND is UNVERIFIABLE rather than negative. The J-Book v1 corpus contains 0 Navy programs (269 Air Force / 67 Space Force / 74 Defense-wide / 0 Navy by service). Virginia-class procurement appears in Navy SCN (Shipbuilding & Conversion, Navy) which is outside the current corpus scope. USAspending corroborates the claim with high-dollar NAVSEA contracts to Curtiss-Wright Electro-Mechanical Corp. Coverage gap noted.

scores.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright supports the Columbia-class submarine program.
supports: USAspending confirms NAVSEA prime contracts (N00104-23-CZA21, N00104-23-CZA20) to Curtiss-Wright Electro-Mechanical Corporation — the legal entity historically responsible for naval main coolant pumps.
scores.interpretation: Same J-Book Navy-coverage gap. Columbia SSBN is a Navy SCN program (top-priority strategic deterrent) outside the v1 corpus. UNVERIFIABLE on framework but qualitatively well corroborated by USAspending; no red flag.

scores.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright is recognizing significant production revenues on the Ford-class aircraft carrier.
supports: USAspending: Curtiss-Wright DoD obligations include NAVSEA awards consistent with carrier program work.
scores.interpretation: CVN-78 Ford-class / CVN-80 Enterprise / CVN-81 Doris Miller are Navy SCN line items, not in v1 J-Book corpus. UNVERIFIABLE; not negative.

scores.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright recognizes development revenues on the SSN(X) next-generation attack submarine.
scores.interpretation: SSN(X) sits in Navy RDT&E (PE 0204114N family) which is outside the Air Force / Space Force / DARPA / MDA / SOCOM corpus scope. NOT_FOUND => UNVERIFIABLE per heuristic 7. Note: this is the most forward-looking, narrative-load-bearing claim and the framework cannot test it; flagged as coverage gap requiring Navy R-2 ingestion.

scores.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright expects growth from Golden Dome funding in 2026 and beyond.
scores.interpretation: Golden Dome is a newly announced FY2026 initiative under MDA / Space Force. The corpus is dated 2026-05-19 and may not yet have a discrete Golden Dome PE entry (program is being constituted from multiple existing MDA / SF PEs). NOT_FOUND => UNVERIFIABLE; the claim is vague ('numerous growth opportunities') and not load-bearing on a specific PE.

scores.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright supplies electronic stabilization to ground combat / tactical vehicles (Stryker, Bradley, Abrams).
supports: USAspending: contract W56JSR20C0012 PACSTAR is an Army contracting office (W56JSR = US Army TACOM / PEO), $47.3M — supports the ground-defense tactical-communications/electronics narrative.
scores.interpretation: Army Procurement (WTCV) line items for ground combat vehicles are not in the v1 J-Book corpus (corpus skews to Air Force RDT&E / Space Force / DARPA). USAspending confirms Army contracting activity (PACSTAR / W56JSR). UNVERIFIABLE via pentagon_jbook, but USAspending supports the underlying revenue source.

scores.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright expects to benefit from C5ISR, electronic warfare, encryption, unmanned systems, communications program funding.
supports: USAspending contractor query (general DoD): 2,362 awards, $325M+ in sample. PACSTAR contract is tactical communications — directly in C5ISR domain.
scores.interpretation: The J-Book corpus does NOT list Curtiss-Wright as a primary contractor on any of its 410 indexed PEs. This is consistent with Curtiss-Wright being a sub-tier supplier (embedded computing boards, COTS modules into prime integrator stacks) rather than a named prime on Air Force RDT&E line items. Claim is intentionally non-specific (no PE named) so framework cannot falsify; UNVERIFIABLE.

supports: USAspending shows $325M in sample DoD obligations to Curtiss-Wright entities — only a subset of historic obligations (top-25 sample), but consistent with a defense-heavy revenue mix.
scores.M_value: n_awards=2362, total_amount=$325M (sample), Department of Defense primary agency
scores.interpretation: Concentration claim is corroborated by directly observable DoD contracting data. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright supplies Reactor Coolant Pumps to the Westinghouse AP1000 design and is pursuing SMR business.
scores.interpretation: EDGAR full-text returned no third-party (e.g., Westinghouse / AP1000 owner-operator) counterparty disclosures referencing Curtiss-Wright RCPs in this cutoff window — but Westinghouse is private (Brookfield-owned) and not a SEC filer, so absence of counterparty disclosure is expected. Claim cannot be falsified via available M-sources; UNVERIFIABLE rather than negative.

scores.claim_text: FY2026 Defense Appropriations Act passed Feb 2026 with base levels consistent with FY25; $113B of OBBBA targeted to FY26 supports a ~13%+ topline defense budget step-up.
scores.interpretation: This is a macro-budget claim, not a programmatic claim. pentagon_jbook does not validate macro appropriations levels. The dollar magnitudes cited ($840B / $895B / $1T discretionary) are appropriations-level, not PE-level. UNVERIFIABLE via the J-Book divergence framework. Note: in this cohort the macro narrative is consistent with the broader 'defense budget up' thesis and does not present a divergence signal.

_meta.framework_coverage_gap: Pentagon J-Book v1 corpus has 0 Navy programs (269 AF / 67 SF / 74 Defense-wide). Curtiss-Wright's three named load-bearing programs (Virginia-class, Columbia-class, Ford-class) and SSN(X) all sit in Navy SCN / Navy RDT&E and are NOT in the corpus. The framework cannot generate a J-Book divergence signal against CW until Navy J-Book data is added. All J-Book-grounded claims therefore land in UNVERIFIABLE rather than PASS or RED.
_meta.coherence_note: USAspending strongly corroborates the underlying revenue narrative (NAVSEA primes via Curtiss-Wright Electro-Mechanical Corp; TACOM via Curtiss-Wright DS for tactical communications). No divergence detected between disclosure and observable contracting activity — but the forward J-Book test cannot run, so this is a NULL RESULT rather than a positive signal.
